name: zcode-blockbox-plugin
description: Bridge the local BlockBox launcher MCP server into ZCode: instances, mods, logs, crash reports, saves, servers, backups and game launching.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把本机方块盒子启动器的本地 MCP 服务器接进 ZCode：查实例、扫模组、读日志、分析崩溃、查存档、备份世界、探服务器、启动游戏，与方块盒子 AI 助手同一套能力。

port.description: Override the BlockBox MCP port. Leave empty to auto-discover from BlockBox settings (default 17890).

token.description: Override the BlockBox MCP access token. Leave empty to auto-discover from BlockBox settings (Windows registry).
